elements.label: AI agent reply bubble
elements.text: Oh no! Let me check on that for you.

pattern.description: A new AI-agent chat message (avatar plus reply bubble) appears below the existing conversation, fading in while drifting up a short distance and settling with a long decelerating tail.
pattern.why_premium: The message lands as one unit with a soft expo-style deceleration instead of popping in, so the conversation reads as a calm, live exchange and the eye is led to the newest line.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.msg-agent-3', {autoAlpha: 0, y: 24}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: 'expo.out'}); avatar and bubble move together (same tween, or avatar 0.02s ahead).
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame: frame - start, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120, mass: 1}}); style={{opacity: p, transform: `translateY(${interpolate(p, [0, 1], [24, 0])}px)`}} applied to the avatar+bubble row.

notes: Filmstrip is a crop around the new message row; the bubble also appears to grow slightly as it rises (camera.scale 0.98 reflects content change, camera.move none). Pattern is the closest canonical fit for a chat message append; a 'chat message append' pattern could be argued.
